entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I received. I'd like to return a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the Aero-Sprint helmet here, delivered 44 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's really just a preference issue. The product photos online made the color look like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a maroon. It’s a great helmet, just not what I was expecting. The box is still unopened.
I understand completely, sometimes the lighting in photos can be tricky. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved the return for a full refund. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just attach that to the package and drop it off.

That's great, thank you for making it so simple. I do plan on ordering a different helmet from you. Since there was a bit of a mix-up with the color representation, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase as a courtesy?

I understand why you're asking, and I appreciate you choosing VeloFit for your replacement. However, our policy is to provide the full refund so you have the funds to purchase exactly what you want. We aren't able to provide additional discounts on top of the return. The primary goal is your safety, and we want to ensure you get the right gear with no compromises.
I see. Well, a full refund is fair. It was worth a shot asking. I'll make sure to get this box unopened and shipped back to you this week.
Thank you for your understanding. Once we receive the item, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
